name: 3-D Medical Image Compression with VOI Coding
aliases: Scalable Compression of 3-D Medical Image Data Using EBCOT with Volume of Interest Coding
definition: A compression method for 3-D medical images that encodes data into independent code-cubes using a modified EBCOT with 3-D contexts, enabling Volume of Interest (VOI) decoding via bit-stream reordering without recoding.
